release_notes: Vengence UI Deep Black Theme: Pure black aesthetics with refined, light-refracting glassmorphism and subtle specular borders
Streamlined Academic Cards: Removed redundant book and grade star icons across Backlog & SGPA views for clean browsing
Clean Neutral Status Pills: Neutral frosted glass indicators and refined aggregate attendance presentation
Enhanced Performance & Polish: Optimized physical mobile APK build (~39 MB) for armeabi-v7a & arm64-v8a
